name: SQLite
summary: Insert the rows of JSON Lines results into a table of a SQLite database file on this computer.

settings.name: path
settings.label: Database file
settings.help: The file is created if it does not exist. Its folder must exist.

egress.note: Writes to a file on this machine and reaches nothing outside it.

implementation.evidence: unit tests and a run through the Windows app on 2026-10-26 (docs/ACCEPTANCE-0.0.1b.md)

notes: Needs a connection of this connector and `policy.approval: always` on the export node (ADR 0016). SQLite is compiled into Ogun; no driver or server is needed.
